clauses.quote: Orders shall be placed as early as necessary each year in order to have textbooks and supplemental materials in the schools prior to the beginning of the first cycle of the school year.
All necessary instructional materials, supplies and textbooks shall be in the classroom before the start of the first duty day.
clauses.subject_text: All necessary instructional materials, supplies and textbooks

clauses.quote: The Year-Round Schools Committee shall continue to meet quarterly (or more often by mutual agreement) for discussion, research and to be a resource in the resolution of year-round school issues.

Unit members and administrators at Year-Round Schools and those planning to move to a Year-Round Calendar status shall collaboratively develop and maintain a roving/rotating plan specific to their sites.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members and administrators at Year-Round Schools and those planning to move to a Year-Round Calendar status

clauses.quote: No Unit Member new to the teaching profession shall be permitted to rove during his/her first year of teaching.
clauses.subject_text: No Unit Member new to the teaching profession

clauses.quote: No Unit Member shall be required to rove a second (third, fourth, etc.) time at their site until all eligible Unit Members at their grade level or within their department have roved.
Unit Members who have been provided a District approved “reasonable accommodation” due to a disability shall not be required to rove.
clauses.subject_text: Unit Members who have been provided a District approved “reasonable accommodation” due to a disability

clauses.quote: Year-round school principals will inform their teachers who want to substitute during their off cycle to submit their names to the site principal and indicate if they want to be on the priority list for a specific school or for all schools.
Each team of four Year-round Rotating, Roving, and Sharing teachers may choose one of the following scenarios:
clauses.subject_text: Each team of four Year-round Rotating, Roving, and Sharing teachers

clauses.quote: Each of the four teachers sharing three classrooms in a rotating arrangement shall be compensated $250 ($1,000 per team) per year.
clauses.subject_text: Each of the four teachers sharing three classrooms in a rotating arrangement

clauses.quote: One of the four teachers who agrees to be a rover shall be compensated $700.
clauses.subject_text: One of the four teachers who agrees to be a rover

clauses.quote: The three (3) teachers who share their rooms with the rover will be compensated $100 per year.
clauses.subject_text: The three (3) teachers who share their rooms with the rover

clauses.quote: Rotating, roving, and sharing teachers will not be required to attend meetings for more than ninety minutes on any duty day they return from off cycle.
Fully credentialed teachers employed on December 31, 2000, and serving in the following hard-to-fill positions shall receive an annual stipend of $800 beginning with the 2000-2001 school year.
clauses.subject_text: Fully credentialed teachers employed on December 31, 2000, and serving in the following hard-to-fill positions
